identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Vemurafenib Adjuvant Therapy in Participants With Surgically Resected Cutaneous BRAF-Mutant Melanoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study of Vemurafenib (RO5185426) Adjuvant Therapy in Patients With Surgically Resected, Cutaneous BRAF-Mutant Melanoma at High Risk for Recurrence

armGroups.label: Cohort 1 Vemurafenib
armGroups.description: Participants with completely resected Stage IIC, IIIA, or IIIB cutaneous melanoma) received vemurafenib, 960 milligrams (mg) twice daily, in 28-day cycles, for up to 52 weeks

armGroups.label: Cohort 1 Placebo
armGroups.description: Participants with completely resected Stage IIC, IIIA, or IIIB cutaneous melanoma) received vemurafenib-matching placebo twice daily, in 28-day cycles, for up to 52 weeks

armGroups.label: Cohort 2 Vemurafenib
armGroups.description: Participants with Stage IIIC cutaneous melanoma received vemurafenib, 960 mg twice daily, in 28-day cycles, for up to 52 weeks

armGroups.label: Cohort 2 Placebo
armGroups.description: Participants with Stage IIIC cutaneous melanoma received vemurafenib-matching placebo twice daily, in 28-day cycles, for up to 52 weeks

interventions.name: Vemurafenib
interventions.description: 4 tablets of vemurafenib 240 mg each (total 960 mg) were administered orally as per the schedule specified in the respective arm.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Placebo matching to vemurafenib were administered orally as per the schedule specified in the respective arm.
